---
name: A rule is wrong or out of date
about: FirstPass says something that doesn't match Google Play's current rules
title: "[Rule] "
labels: rule
---

**Which finding or check?**
The title as FirstPass shows it, for example "People must be able to delete their account in the app".

**What does FirstPass say?**

**What does Google say?**
Link to Google's own page, and the date you read it:

**What should change?**
- [ ] The rule is wrong and shouldn't apply
- [ ] A number or date is out of date
- [ ] A rule is missing
- [ ] The explanation is unclear

**Details**
In your own words, please. Don't paste Google's policy text.
